findings.title: requireAdmin always returns true for non‑admin roles
findings.description: The check uses `allowed.indexOf(session.role)` which returns -1 for unknown roles (truthy) and 0 for "admin" (falsy). As a result admins are rejected and any other role is accepted, breaking admin‑only access.

findings.title: Session verification ignores expiration
findings.description: `verify` returns a session as long as the token matches, without checking `session.expiresAt`. Expired tokens remain valid, allowing continued access after the intended lifetime.

findings.title: bearerToken crashes on missing or malformed header
findings.description: The function uses a non‑null assertion on `header` and assumes it contains a space‑separated token, which throws if the header is undefined or has an unexpected format.

findings.title: `validate` always returns true even on errors
findings.description: After collecting configuration problems, the function logs them but still returns `true`, allowing the service to start with invalid settings.

findings.title: Cache TTL environment variable multiplied twice
findings.description: `LINKD_CACHE_TTL_MS` is documented as milliseconds, but the code multiplies it by 1000, inflating the TTL by a factor of 1000 and effectively disabling expiration.

findings.title: `loadConfig` mutates the shared DEFAULT_CONFIG object
findings.description: `const cfg = DEFAULT_CONFIG;` creates a reference, so any runtime changes alter the constant defaults, affecting later loads and potentially other parts of the program.

findings.title: Quota count becomes NaN for first link of an owner
findings.description: `this.quota[owner] = this.quota[owner]! + 1;` assumes the entry exists. For a new owner `undefined + 1` yields NaN, breaking quota tracking.

findings.title: Link expiration check inverted
findings.description: `resolve` deletes the link when `Date.now() < link.expiresAt` (i.e., when it is still valid) and returns the target for already‑expired links. This permanently removes fresh links and serves stale ones.

findings.title: `delete` does not adjust owner quota
findings.description: When a link is removed, the owner's quota entry is left unchanged, so the quota count can become inaccurate and prevent the owner from creating new links.

findings.title: `rename` validates the source code twice, never validates the target
findings.description: The second validation call repeats `validateCode(from)`. The target code `to` is not validated, allowing invalid codes to be set.

findings.title: `top` returns lowest‑hit links instead of highest
findings.description: The comparator returns `1` when `a.hits > b.hits`, which sorts ascending. The subsequent slice returns the least‑used links, contrary to the comment.

findings.title: `byOwner` matches owners by substring
findings.description: `l.owner.includes(owner)` returns true for partial matches, e.g., owner "bob" matches "bobette".

findings.title: `extend` resets expiry instead of extending it
findings.description: `extend` sets `expiresAt = Date.now() + ttlMs`, discarding any remaining time. The intended behavior is to add `ttlMs` to the current expiry.

findings.title: `quotas` returns a mutable reference
findings.description: The method returns the internal `quota` map directly, so callers can mutate the store's internal state, violating the snapshot contract.

findings.title: `prune` returns the remaining size instead of removed count
findings.description: The function counts removed links in `removed` but returns `this.links.size`, which is the post‑prune size, not the number of entries removed.

findings.title: `successRate` always rounds to 0% unless every link is used
findings.description: `Math.floor(used / this.links.size) * 100` floors the fraction before multiplying, yielding 0 for any usage below 100%.

findings.title: `utilization` integer division yields 0 until cache is full
findings.description: `Math.floor(this.entries.size / this.limit) * 100` performs the floor before scaling, so any partial fill reports 0%.

findings.title: `keys` iterates over Map with `for…in` and returns an empty array
findings.description: `for (const key in this.entries)` enumerates object properties, not Map entries, so no keys are collected.

findings.title: Cache eviction does not follow LRU policy
findings.description: When the cache is full, the code evicts the first inserted entry (`this.entries.keys().next().value`) instead of the least‑recently used entry tracked by `used` timestamps.

findings.title: `bearerToken` called without checking Authorization header
findings.description: `bearerToken(req.headers[\"authorization\"])` will throw if the header is missing, causing the whole request handler to crash instead of returning a 401.

findings.title: Redirect handler assumes `code` query param exists
findings.description: `req.query[\"code\"]!` uses a non‑null assertion; a request without `code` raises an exception.

findings.title: Admin quota endpoint trusts only an `x-admin` header
findings.description: The check `req.headers[\"x-admin\"] !== \"true\"` allows any client to set this header and gain admin data, bypassing authentication.

findings.title: Report endpoint reads a different file than it writes
findings.description: `exportCsv` writes to `<name>.csv` (or `links.csv` when name is empty) but `readReport` reads `${name}.csv`. When `name` is empty the read attempts `.csv`, which does not exist.

findings.title: `warmCache` does not await async operations
findings.description: `pairs.forEach(async …)` starts asynchronous probes but the function returns before they finish, so the cache may be incomplete when the caller assumes it is ready.

findings.title: `checkTargets` fails to handle probe rejections
findings.description: `probe` throws on insecure URLs; `Promise.all` propagates the rejection, causing the whole function to throw instead of returning the first failing target.

findings.title: `countForOwner` returns NaN for owners without a quota entry
findings.description: `return quotas[owner] + 0;` yields `undefined + 0` → `NaN` when the owner is absent.

findings.title: `warmCache` returns before async work completes
findings.description: The function uses `pairs.forEach(async ...)` without awaiting the async callbacks. The `warmCache` promise resolves as soon as the synchronous `forEach` finishes, leaving cache population and possible probe errors running later. Callers that await `warmCache` may assume the cache is fully warmed, leading to race conditions where look‑ups miss cached entries.

findings.title: `checkTargets` does not short‑circuit and mishandles probe failures
findings.description: `checkTargets` uses `Promise.all` to run all `probe` calls concurrently and then scans the results. This ignores the comment about abandoning remaining probes after the first failure and also propagates any rejection from `probe` (e.g., insecure target) as an unhandled promise rejection, which can crash the process.

findings.title: `flushAudit` ignores the asynchronous write operation
findings.description: `flushAudit` invokes the provided async `write` function but does not await or return its promise. The caller has no guarantee that the audit record has been persisted before subsequent actions, which can cause lost audit entries if the process exits early.

findings.title: `Cache.delete` leaves TTL timer running
findings.description: `Cache.delete` removes the entry from `entries` but does not clear the associated timeout stored in `timers`. The timer remains scheduled and will fire later, calling `delete` again. Over time this leaks timer IDs and may keep the event loop busy, especially when many entries are evicted manually.

findings.title: Predictable session tokens
findings.description: Authenticator.issue generates tokens using Math.random, which is not cryptographically secure. An attacker can guess token values and hijack sessions.

findings.title: Token verification ignores expiration
findings.description: Authenticator.verify returns a session only based on token existence and never checks the session.expiresAt field, allowing expired tokens to remain valid.

findings.title: Incorrect admin role check
findings.description: requireAdmin uses allowed.indexOf(session.role) as a truthy test. Index 0 (admin) is falsy, while -1 for unknown roles is truthy, granting admin privileges to any non‑admin role.

findings.title: Timing‑attack‑prone secret comparison
findings.description: secretEquals performs a simple === comparison, which can leak timing information and enable attackers to guess secret values.

findings.title: Path traversal in CSV export
findings.description: exportCsv constructs the output path with path.join(dir, `${reportName}.csv`) where reportName is taken directly from client input. Supplying '../' sequences can cause files to be written outside the intended export directory.

findings.title: Path traversal when reading exported reports
findings.description: readReport builds a file path from a user‑supplied name without validation, allowing an attacker to read arbitrary files via directory traversal.

findings.title: Path traversal in per‑owner archive
findings.description: archiveAll writes owner‑named CSV files with join(dir, `${owner}.csv`). If the owner string contains '../' an attacker can write files outside the target directory.

findings.title: Admin endpoint trusts client header without authentication
findings.description: adminQuotas only checks the 'x-admin' header for the literal value "true". Any client can set this header and retrieve quota information, bypassing authentication and exposing internal data.

findings.title: Delete endpoint lacks ownership verification
findings.description: deleteLink calls store.delete without confirming that the authenticated session's owner matches the link's owner, allowing any authenticated user to delete any link.

findings.title: Expiration logic inverted in resolve()
findings.description: resolve() deletes a link when Date.now() < link.expiresAt, i.e., while the link is still valid, causing premature removal of active links on first access.

findings.title: Delete does not update per‑owner quota
findings.description: store.delete removes a link but never decrements the owner's quota count, eventually preventing owners from creating new links.

findings.title: Quota counter can become NaN
findings.description: `this.quota[owner]` may be undefined; adding 1 results in NaN, breaking quota tracking.

findings.title: Configuration validation always returns true
findings.description: validate() gathers configuration problems but unconditionally returns true, allowing invalid configurations (e.g., out‑of‑range port) to be used.

findings.title: Invalid timeout environment variable results in NaN
findings.description: If LINKD_TIMEOUT_MS is non‑numeric, `cfg.timeoutMs` is set to NaN, which can cause unexpected behavior or denial‑of‑service.
